name: AppDrawer
summary: An app drawer you can open with a programmable key
description: Open your apps from a standalone activity. Keep this if your convenience or PTT key is configured to open AppDrawer.
author: thooton

changes.text: Publish packages with the checked-in signing keys.
Release signing: the release key comes from the environment, never from the repository.
Nothing hard-codes the installed id, so a copy under another id installs beside the original.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Carrying an app no longer makes the grid jump, and a lifted app shows as a solid lavender card.
Canvas no longer shows up twice, once as a blank Todo.
Round every app's launcher icon like Canvas and Books.
Rename to Launcher and give it a real icon.
